answer: An agent credit pool can stop aliases from multiplying borrowing power by requiring each loan to reference locked collateral in one shared registry. If borrower sable locks a quartz token, its serial is marked encumbered until repayment or liquidation; another account cannot pledge it again. Even a thousand basalt shell companies must supply fresh collateral for additional loans. Conservative valuations and liquidation margins still matter: this blocks repeated pledges, not price manipulation or unique-owner fraud.
